    97→
    98→	// Get the agent for hook input parsing and session ID transformation
    99→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   100→	if err != nil {
   101→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   102→	}
   103→
   104→	// Parse hook input using agent interface
   105→	input, err := ag.ParseHookInput(agent.HookStop, os.Stdin)
   106→	if err != nil {
   107→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse hook input: %w", err)
   108→	}
   109→
   110→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   111→	logging.Info(logCtx, "stop",
   112→		slog.String("hook", "stop"),
   113→		slog.String("hook_type", "agent"),
   114→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
   115→		slog.String("transcript_path", input.SessionRef),
   116→	)
   117→
   118→	sessionID := input.SessionID
   119→	if sessionID == "" {
   120→		sessionID = unknownSessionID
   121→	}
   122→
   123→	transcriptPath := input.SessionRef
   124→	if transcriptPath == "" || !fileExists(transcriptPath) {
   125→		return fmt.Errorf("transcript file not found or empty: %s", transcriptPath)
   126→	}
   127→
   128→	// Create session metadata folder using the entire session ID (preserves original date on resume)
   129→	// Use AbsPath to ensure we create at repo root, not relative to cwd
   130→	sessionDir := paths.SessionMetadataDirFromSessionID(sessionID)
   131→	sessionDirAbs, err := paths.AbsPath(sessionDir)
   132→	if err != nil {
   133→		sessionDirAbs = sessionDir // Fallback to relative
   134→	}
   135→	if err := os.MkdirAll(sessionDirAbs, 0o750); err != nil {
   136→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create session directory: %w", err)
   137→	}
   138→
   139→	// Wait for Claude Code to flush the transcript file.
   140→	// The stop hook fires before the transcript is fully written to disk.
   141→	// We poll for our own hook_progress sentinel entry in the file tail,
   142→	// which guarantees all prior entries have been flushed.
   143→	waitForTranscriptFlush(transcriptPath, time.Now())
   144→
   145→	// Copy transcript
   146→	logFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.TranscriptFileName)
   147→	if err := copyFile(transcriptPath, logFile); err != nil {
   148→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to copy transcript: %w", err)
   149→	}
   150→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Copied transcript to: %s\n", sessionDir+"/"+paths.TranscriptFileName)
   151→
   152→	// Load pre-prompt state (captured on UserPromptSubmit)
   153→	// Needed for transcript offset and file change detection
   154→	preState, err := LoadPrePromptState(sessionID)
   155→	if err != nil {
   156→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load pre-prompt state: %v\n", err)
   157→	}
   158→
   159→	// Determine transcript offset: prefer pre-prompt state, fall back to session state.
   160→	// Pre-prompt state has the offset when the transcript path was available at prompt time.
   161→	// Session state has the offset updated after each successful checkpoint save (auto-commit).
   162→	var transcriptOffset int
   163→	if preState != nil && preState.StepTranscriptStart > 0 {
   164→		transcriptOffset = preState.StepTranscriptStart
   165→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Pre-prompt state found: parsing transcript from line %d\n", transcriptOffset)
   166→	} else {
   167→		// Fall back to session state (e.g., auto-commit strategy updates it after each save)
   168→		sessionState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionID)
   169→		if loadErr != nil {
   170→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load session state: %v\n", loadErr)
   171→		}
   172→		if sessionState != nil && sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart > 0 {
   173→			transcriptOffset = sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart
   174→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Session state found: parsing transcript from line %d\n", transcriptOffset)
   175→		}
   176→	}
   177→
   178→	// Parse transcript (optionally from offset for strategies that track transcript position)
   179→	// When transcriptOffset > 0, only parse NEW lines since the last checkpoint
   180→	var transcript []transcriptLine
   181→	var totalLines int
   182→	if transcriptOffset > 0 {
   183→		// Parse only NEW lines since last checkpoint
   184→		transcript, totalLines, err = parseTranscriptFromLine(transcriptPath, transcriptOffset)
   185→		if err != nil {
   186→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse transcript from line %d: %w", transcriptOffset, err)
   187→		}
   188→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Parsed %d new transcript lines (total: %d)\n", len(transcript), totalLines)
   189→	} else {
   190→		// First prompt or no session state - parse entire transcript
   191→		// Use parseTranscriptFromLine with offset 0 to also get totalLines
   192→		transcript, totalLines, err = parseTranscriptFromLine(transcriptPath, 0)
   193→		if err != nil {
   194→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse transcript: %w", err)
   195→		}
   196→	}
   197→
   198→	// Extract all prompts since last checkpoint for prompt file
   199→	allPrompts := extractUserPrompts(transcript)
   200→	promptFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.PromptFileName)
   201→	promptContent := strings.Join(allPrompts, "\n\n---\n\n")
   202→	if err := os.WriteFile(promptFile, []byte(promptContent), 0o600); err != nil {
   203→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write prompt file: %w", err)
   204→	}
   205→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Extracted %d prompt(s) to: %s\n", len(allPrompts), sessionDir+"/"+paths.PromptFileName)
   206→
   207→	// Extract summary
   208→	summaryFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.SummaryFileName)
   209→	summary := extractLastAssistantMessage(transcript)
   210→	if err := os.WriteFile(summaryFile, []byte(summary), 0o600); err != nil {
   211→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write summary file: %w", err)
   212→	}
   213→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Extracted summary to: %s\n", sessionDir+"/"+paths.SummaryFileName)
   214→
   215→	// Get modified files from transcript
   216→	modifiedFiles := extractModifiedFiles(transcript)
   217→
   218→	// Generate commit message from last user prompt
   219→	lastPrompt := ""
   220→	if len(allPrompts) > 0 {
   221→		lastPrompt = allPrompts[len(allPrompts)-1]
   222→	}
   223→	commitMessage := generateCommitMessage(lastPrompt)
   224→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Using commit message: %s\n", commitMessage)
   225→
   226→	// Get repo root for path conversion (not cwd, since Claude may be in a subdirectory)
   227→	// Using cwd would filter out files in sibling directories (paths starting with ..)
   228→	repoRoot, err := paths.RepoRoot()
   229→	if err != nil {
   230→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get repo root: %w", err)
   231→	}
   232→
   233→	if preState != nil {
   234→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Pre-prompt state: %d pre-existing untracked files\n", len(preState.UntrackedFiles))
   235→	}
   236→
   237→	// Compute new and deleted files (single git status call)
   238→	newFiles, deletedFiles, err := ComputeFileChanges(preState)
   239→	if err != nil {
   240→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to compute file changes: %v\n", err)
   241→	}
   242→
   243→	// Filter and normalize all paths (CLI responsibility)
   244→	relModifiedFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(modifiedFiles, repoRoot)
   245→	relNewFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(newFiles, repoRoot)
   246→	relDeletedFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(deletedFiles, repoRoot)
   247→
   248→	// Check if there are any changes to commit
   249→	totalChanges := len(relModifiedFiles) + len(relNewFiles) + len(relDeletedFiles)
   250→	if totalChanges == 0 {
   251→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "No files were modified during this session\n")
   252→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Skipping commit\n")
   253→		// Still transition phase even when skipping commit — the turn is ending.
   254→		transitionSessionTurnEnd(sessionID)
   255→		// Clean up state even when skipping
   256→		if err := CleanupPrePromptState(sessionID); err != nil {
   257→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to cleanup pre-prompt state: %v\n", err)
   258→		}
   259→		return nil
   260→	}
   261→
   262→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Files modified during session (%d):\n", len(relModifiedFiles))
   263→	for _, file := range relModifiedFiles {
   264→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  - %s\n", file)
   265→	}
   266→	if len(relNewFiles) > 0 {
   267→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "New files created (%d):\n", len(relNewFiles))
   268→		for _, file := range relNewFiles {
   269→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  + %s\n", file)
   270→		}
   271→	}
   272→	if len(relDeletedFiles) > 0 {
   273→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Files deleted (%d):\n", len(relDeletedFiles))
   274→		for _, file := range relDeletedFiles {
   275→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  - %s\n", file)
   276→		}
   277→	}
   278→
   279→	// Create context file before saving changes
   280→	contextFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.ContextFileName)
   281→	if err := createContextFileMinimal(contextFile, commitMessage, sessionID, promptFile, summaryFile, transcript); err != nil {
   282→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create context file: %w", err)
   283→	}
   284→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Created context file: %s\n", sessionDir+"/"+paths.ContextFileName)
   285→
   286→	// Get git author from local/global config
   287→	author, err := GetGitAuthor()
   288→	if err != nil {
   289→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get git author: %w", err)
   290→	}
   291→
   292→	// Get the configured strategy
   293→	strat := GetStrategy()
   294→
   295→	// Ensure strategy setup is in place (auto-installs git hook, gitignore, etc. if needed)
   296→	if err := strat.EnsureSetup(); err != nil {
   297→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to ensure strategy setup: %v\n", err)
   298→	}
   299→
   300→	// Get agent type from the currently executing hook agent (authoritative source)
   301→	var agentType agent.AgentType
   302→	if hookAgent, agentErr := GetCurrentHookAgent(); agentErr == nil {
   303→		agentType = hookAgent.Type()
   304→	}
   305→
   306→	// Get transcript position from pre-prompt state (captured at step/turn start)
   307→	var transcriptIdentifierAtStart string
   308→	var transcriptLinesAtStart int
   309→	if preState != nil {
   310→		transcriptIdentifierAtStart = preState.LastTranscriptIdentifier
   311→		transcriptLinesAtStart = preState.StepTranscriptStart
   312→	}
   313→
   314→	// Calculate token usage for this checkpoint (Claude Code specific)
   315→	var tokenUsage *agent.TokenUsage
   316→	if transcriptPath != "" {
   317→		// Subagents are stored in a subagents/ directory next to the main transcript
   318→		subagentsDir := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(transcriptPath), sessionID, "subagents")
   319→		usage, err := claudecode.CalculateTotalTokenUsage(transcriptPath, transcriptLinesAtStart, subagentsDir)
   320→		if err != nil {
   321→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to calculate token usage: %v\n", err)
   322→		} else {
   323→			tokenUsage = usage
   324→		}
   325→	}
   326→
   327→	// Build fully-populated save context and delegate to strategy
   328→	ctx := strategy.SaveContext{
   329→		SessionID:                sessionID,
   330→		ModifiedFiles:            relModifiedFiles,
   331→		NewFiles:                 relNewFiles,
   332→		DeletedFiles:             relDeletedFiles,
   333→		MetadataDir:              sessionDir,
   334→		MetadataDirAbs:           sessionDirAbs,
   335→		CommitMessage:            commitMessage,
   336→		TranscriptPath:           transcriptPath,
   337→		AuthorName:               author.Name,
   338→		AuthorEmail:              author.Email,
   339→		AgentType:                agentType,
   340→		StepTranscriptIdentifier: transcriptIdentifierAtStart,
   341→		StepTranscriptStart:      transcriptLinesAtStart,
   342→		TokenUsage:               tokenUsage,
   343→	}
   344→
   345→	if err := strat.SaveChanges(ctx); err != nil {
   346→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save changes: %w", err)
   347→	}
   348→
   349→	// Update session state with new transcript position for strategies that create
   350→	// commits on the active branch (auto-commit strategy). This prevents parsing old transcript
   351→	// lines on subsequent checkpoints.
   352→	// Note: Shadow strategy tracks transcript position per-step via StepTranscriptStart in
   353→	// pre-prompt state, but doesn't advance CheckpointTranscriptStart in session state because
   354→	// its checkpoints accumulate all files touched across the entire session.
   355→	if strat.Name() == strategy.StrategyNameAutoCommit {
   356→		// Load session state for updating transcript position
   357→		sessionState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionID)
   358→		if loadErr != nil {
   359→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load session state: %v\n", loadErr)
   360→		}
   361→		// Create session state lazily if it doesn't exist (backward compat for resumed sessions
   362→		// or if InitializeSession was never called/failed)
   363→		if sessionState == nil {
   364→			sessionState = &strategy.SessionState{
   365→				SessionID: sessionID,
   366→			}
   367→		}
   368→		sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart = totalLines
   369→		sessionState.StepCount++
   370→		if updateErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(sessionState); updateErr != nil {
   371→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to update session state: %v\n", updateErr)
   372→		} else {
   373→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Updated session state: transcript position=%d, checkpoint=%d\n",
   374→				totalLines, sessionState.StepCount)
   375→		}
   376→	}
   377→
   378→	// Fire EventTurnEnd to transition session phase (all strategies).
   379→	// This moves ACTIVE → IDLE or ACTIVE_COMMITTED → IDLE.
   380→	// TODO(ENT-221): dispatch ActionCondense for ACTIVE_COMMITTED → IDLE transitions.
   381→	transitionSessionTurnEnd(sessionID)
   382→
   383→	// Clean up pre-prompt state (CLI responsibility)
   384→	if err := CleanupPrePromptState(sessionID); err != nil {
   385→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to cleanup pre-prompt state: %v\n", err)
   386→	}
   387→
   388→	return nil
   389→}
   390→
   391→// handleClaudeCodePostTodo handles the PostToolUse[TodoWrite] hook for subagent checkpoints.
   392→// Creates a checkpoint if we're in a subagent context (active pre-task file exists).
   393→// Skips silently if not in subagent context (main agent).
   394→func handleClaudeCodePostTodo() error {
   395→	input, err := parseSubagentCheckpointHookInput(os.Stdin)
   396→	if err != nil {
   397→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse PostToolUse[TodoWrite] input: %w", err)
   398→	}
   399→
   400→	// Get agent for logging context
   401→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   402→	if err != nil {
   403→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   404→	}
   405→
   406→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   407→	logging.Info(logCtx, "post-todo",
   408→		slog.String("hook", "post-todo"),
   409→		slog.String("hook_type", "subagent"),
   410→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
   411→		slog.String("transcript_path", input.TranscriptPath),
   412→		slog.String("tool_use_id", input.ToolUseID),
   413→	)
   414→
   415→	// Check if we're in a subagent context by looking for an active pre-task file
   416→	taskToolUseID, found := FindActivePreTaskFile()
   417→	if !found {
   418→		// Not in subagent context - this is a main agent TodoWrite, skip
   419→		return nil
   420→	}
   421→
   422→	// Skip on default branch to avoid polluting main/master history
   423→	if skip, branchName := ShouldSkipOnDefaultBranch(); skip {
   424→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Entire: skipping incremental checkpoint on branch '%s'\n", branchName)
   425→		return nil
   426→	}
   427→
   428→	// Detect file changes since last checkpoint
   429→	modified, newFiles, deleted, err := DetectChangedFiles()
   430→	if err != nil {
   431→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to detect changed files: %v\n", err)
   432→		return nil
   433→	}
   434→
   435→	// If no file changes, skip creating a checkpoint
   436→	if len(modified) == 0 && len(newFiles) == 0 && len(deleted) == 0 {
   437→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] No file changes detected, skipping incremental checkpoint\n")
   438→		return nil
   439→	}
   440→
   441→	// Get git author
   442→	author, err := GetGitAuthor()
   443→	if err != nil {
   444→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to get git author: %v\n", err)
   445→		return nil
   446→	}
   447→
   448→	// Get the active strategy
   449→	strat := GetStrategy()
   450→
   451→	// Ensure strategy setup is complete
   452→	if err := strat.EnsureSetup(); err != nil {
   453→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to ensure strategy setup: %v\n", err)
   454→		return nil
   455→	}
   456→
   457→	// Get the session ID from the transcript path or input, then transform to Entire session ID
   458→	sessionID := input.SessionID
   459→	if sessionID == "" {
   460→		sessionID = paths.ExtractSessionIDFromTranscriptPath(input.TranscriptPath)
   461→	}
   462→
   463→	// Get next checkpoint sequence
   464→	seq := GetNextCheckpointSequence(sessionID, taskToolUseID)
   465→
   466→	// Extract the todo content from the tool_input.
   467→	// PostToolUse receives the NEW todo list where the just-completed work is
   468→	// marked as "completed". The last completed item is the work that was just done.
   469→	todoContent := ExtractLastCompletedTodoFromToolInput(input.ToolInput)
   470→	if todoContent == "" {
   471→		// No completed items - this is likely the first TodoWrite (planning phase).
   472→		// Check if there are any todos at all to avoid duplicate messages.
   473→		todoCount := CountTodosFromToolInput(input.ToolInput)
   474→		if todoCount > 0 {
   475→			// Use "Planning: N todos" format for the first TodoWrite
   476→			todoContent = fmt.Sprintf("Planning: %d todos", todoCount)
   477→		}
   478→		// If todoCount == 0, todoContent remains empty and FormatIncrementalMessage
   479→		// will fall back to "Checkpoint #N" format
   480→	}
   481→
   482→	// Get agent type from the currently executing hook agent (authoritative source)
   483→	var agentType agent.AgentType
   484→	if hookAgent, agentErr := GetCurrentHookAgent(); agentErr == nil {
   485→		agentType = hookAgent.Type()
   486→	}
   487→
   488→	// Build incremental checkpoint context
   489→	ctx := strategy.TaskCheckpointContext{
   490→		SessionID:           sessionID,
   491→		ToolUseID:           taskToolUseID,
   492→		ModifiedFiles:       modified,
   493→		NewFiles:            newFiles,
   494→		DeletedFiles:        deleted,
   495→		TranscriptPath:      input.TranscriptPath,
   496→		AuthorName:          author.Name,
   497→		AuthorEmail:         author.Email,
   498→		IsIncremental:       true,
   499→		IncrementalSequence: seq,
   500→		IncrementalType:     input.ToolName,
   501→		IncrementalData:     input.ToolInput,
   502→		TodoContent:         todoContent,
   503→		AgentType:           agentType,
   504→	}
   505→
   506→	// Save incremental checkpoint
   507→	if err := strat.SaveTaskCheckpoint(ctx); err != nil {
   508→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to save incremental checkpoint: %v\n", err)
   509→		return nil
   510→	}
   511→
   512→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Created incremental checkpoint #%d for %s (task: %s)\n",
   513→		seq, input.ToolName, taskToolUseID[:min(12, len(taskToolUseID))])
   514→	return nil
   515→}
   516→
   517→// handleClaudeCodePreTask handles the PreToolUse[Task] hook
   518→func handleClaudeCodePreTask() error {
   519→	// Skip on default branch for strategies that don't allow it
   520→	if skip, branchName := ShouldSkipOnDefaultBranchForStrategy(); skip {
   521→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Entire: skipping on branch '%s' - create a feature branch to use Entire tracking\n", branchName)
   522→		return nil // Don't fail the hook, just skip
   523→	}
   524→
   525→	input, err := parseTaskHookInput(os.Stdin)
   526→	if err != nil {
   527→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse PreToolUse[Task] input: %w", err)
   528→	}
   529→
   530→	// Get agent for logging context
   531→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   532→	if err != nil {
   533→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   534→	}
   535→
   536→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   537→	logging.Info(logCtx, "pre-task",
   538→		slog.String("hook", "pre-task"),
   539→		slog.String("hook_type", "subagent"),
   540→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
   541→		slog.String("transcript_path", input.TranscriptPath),
   542→		slog.String("tool_use_id", input.ToolUseID),
   543→	)
   544→
   545→	// Log context to stdout
   546→	logPreTaskHookContext(os.Stdout, input)
   547→
   548→	// Capture pre-task state locally (for computing new files when task completes).
   549→	// We don't create a shadow branch commit here. Commits are created during
   550→	// task completion (handleClaudeCodePostTask/handleClaudeCodePostTodo) only if the task resulted
   551→	// in file changes.
   552→	if err := CapturePreTaskState(input.ToolUseID); err != nil {
   553→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to capture pre-task state: %w", err)
   554→	}
   555→
   556→	return nil
   557→}
   558→
   559→// handleClaudeCodePostTask handles the PostToolUse[Task] hook
   560→func handleClaudeCodePostTask() error {
   561→	// Skip on default branch for strategies that don't allow it
   562→	if skip, branchName := ShouldSkipOnDefaultBranchForStrategy(); skip {
   563→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Entire: skipping on branch '%s' - create a feature branch to use Entire tracking\n", branchName)
   564→		return nil // Don't fail the hook, just skip
   565→	}
   566→
   567→	input, err := parsePostTaskHookInput(os.Stdin)
   568→	if err != nil {
   569→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse PostToolUse[Task] input: %w", err)
   570→	}
   571→
   572→	// Extract subagent type from tool_input for logging
   573→	subagentType, taskDescription := ParseSubagentTypeAndDescription(input.ToolInput)
   574→
   575→	// Get agent for logging context
   576→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   577→	if err != nil {
   578→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   579→	}
   580→
   581→	// Log parsed input context
   582→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   583→	logging.Info(logCtx, "post-task",
   584→		slog.String("hook", "post-task"),
   585→		slog.String("hook_type", "subagent"),
   586→		slog.String("tool_use_id", input.ToolUseID),
   587→		slog.String("agent_id", input.AgentID),
   588→		slog.String("subagent_type", subagentType),
   589→	)
   590→
   591→	// Determine subagent transcript path
   592→	transcriptDir := filepath.Dir(input.TranscriptPath)
   593→	var subagentTranscriptPath string
   594→	if input.AgentID != "" {
   595→		subagentTranscriptPath = AgentTranscriptPath(transcriptDir, input.AgentID)
   596→		if !fileExists(subagentTranscriptPath) {
   597→			subagentTranscriptPath = ""
   598→		}
   599→	}
   600→
   601→	// Log context to stdout
   602→	logPostTaskHookContext(os.Stdout, input, subagentTranscriptPath)
   603→
   604→	// Parse transcript to extract modified files
   605→	var modifiedFiles []string

   636→	repoRoot, err := paths.RepoRoot()

   643→	relNewFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(newFiles, repoRoot)

   650→		return nil

   654→	transcript, _ := parseTranscript(input.TranscriptPath) //nolint:errcheck // best-effort extraction

   708→// handleClaudeCodeSessionStart handles the SessionStart hook for Claude Code.
   709→func handleClaudeCodeSessionStart() error {

   712→
   713→// handleClaudeCodeSessionEnd handles the SessionEnd hook for Claude Code.
   714→// This fires when the user explicitly closes the session.
   715→// Updates the session state with EndedAt timestamp.
   716→func handleClaudeCodeSessionEnd() error {
   717→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   718→	if err != nil {
   719→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   720→	}
   721→
   722→	input, err := ag.ParseHookInput(agent.HookSessionEnd, os.Stdin)
   723→	if err != nil {
   724→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse hook input: %w", err)
   725→	}
   726→
   727→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   728→	logging.Info(logCtx, "session-end",
   729→		slog.String("hook", "session-end"),
   730→		slog.String("hook_type", "agent"),
   731→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
   732→	)
   733→
   734→	if input.SessionID == "" {
   735→		return nil // No session to update
   736→	}
   737→
   738→	// Best-effort cleanup - don't block session closure on failure
   739→	if err := markSessionEnded(input.SessionID); err != nil {
   740→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to mark session ended: %v\n", err)
   741→	}
   742→	return nil
   743→}

   745→// transitionSessionTurnEnd fires EventTurnEnd to move the session from
   746→// ACTIVE → IDLE (or ACTIVE_COMMITTED → IDLE). Best-effort: logs warnings
   747→// on failure rather than returning errors.
   748→func transitionSessionTurnEnd(sessionID string) {
   749→	turnState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionID)
   750→	if loadErr != nil {
   751→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load session state for turn end: %v\n", loadErr)
   752→		return
   753→	}
   754→	if turnState == nil {
   755→		return
   756→	}
   757→	remaining := strategy.TransitionAndLog(turnState, session.EventTurnEnd, session.TransitionContext{})
   758→
   759→	// Dispatch strategy-specific actions (e.g., ActionCondense for ACTIVE_COMMITTED → IDLE)
   760→	if len(remaining) > 0 {
   761→		strat := GetStrategy()
   762→		if handler, ok := strat.(strategy.TurnEndHandler); ok {
   763→			if err := handler.HandleTurnEnd(turnState, remaining); err != nil {
   764→				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: turn-end action dispatch failed: %v\n", err)
   765→			}
   766→		}
   767→	}
   768→
   769→	if updateErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(turnState); updateErr != nil {
   770→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to update session phase on turn end: %v\n", updateErr)
   771→	}
   772→}

   774→// markSessionEnded transitions the session to ENDED phase via the state machine.
   775→func markSessionEnded(sessionID string) error {
   776→	state, err := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionID)
   777→	if err != nil {
   778→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load session state: %w", err)
   779→	}
   780→	if state == nil {
   781→		return nil // No state file, nothing to update
   782→	}
   783→
   784→	strategy.TransitionAndLog(state, session.EventSessionStop, session.TransitionContext{})
   785→
   786→	now := time.Now()
   787→	state.EndedAt = &now
   788→
   789→	if err := strategy.SaveSessionState(state); err != nil {
   790→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save session state: %w", err)
   791→	}
   792→	return nil
   793→}

   795→// stopHookSentinel is the string that appears in Claude Code's hook_progress
   796→// transcript entry when it launches our stop hook. Used to detect that the
   797→// transcript file has been fully flushed before we copy it.
   798→const stopHookSentinel = "hooks claude-code stop"
   799→
   800→// waitForTranscriptFlush polls the transcript file tail for the hook_progress
   801→// sentinel entry that Claude Code writes when launching the stop hook.
   802→// Once this entry appears in the file, all prior entries (assistant replies,
   803→// tool results) are guaranteed to have been flushed.
   804→//
   805→// hookStartTime is the approximate time our process started, used to avoid
   806→// matching stale sentinel entries from previous stop hook invocations.
   807→//
   808→// Falls back silently after a timeout — the transcript copy will proceed
   809→// with whatever data is available.
   810→func waitForTranscriptFlush(transcriptPath string, hookStartTime time.Time) {
   811→	const (
   812→		maxWait      = 3 * time.Second
   813→		pollInterval = 50 * time.Millisecond
   814→		tailBytes    = 4096 // Read last 4KB — sentinel is near the end
   815→		maxSkew      = 10 * time.Second
   816→	)
   817→
   818→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks")
   819→	deadline := time.Now().Add(maxWait)
   820→	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
   821→		if checkStopSentinel(transcriptPath, tailBytes, hookStartTime, maxSkew) {
   822→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "transcript flush sentinel found",
   823→				slog.Duration("wait", time.Since(hookStartTime)),
   824→			)
   825→			return
   826→		}
   827→		time.Sleep(pollInterval)
   828→	}
   829→	// Timeout — proceed with whatever is on disk.
   830→	logging.Warn(logCtx, "transcript flush sentinel not found within timeout, proceeding",
   831→		slog.Duration("timeout", maxWait),
   832→	)
   833→}
   834→
   835→// checkStopSentinel reads the tail of the transcript file and looks for a
   836→// hook_progress entry containing the stop hook sentinel, with a timestamp
   837→// close to hookStartTime.
   838→func checkStopSentinel(path string, tailBytes int64, hookStartTime time.Time, maxSkew time.Duration) bool {
   839→	f, err := os.Open(path) //nolint:gosec // path comes from agent hook input
   840→	if err != nil {
   841→		return false
   842→	}
   843→	defer f.Close()
   844→
   845→	// Seek to tail
   846→	info, err := f.Stat()
   847→	if err != nil {
   848→		return false
   849→	}
   850→	offset := info.Size() - tailBytes
   851→	if offset < 0 {
   852→		offset = 0
   853→	}
   854→	buf := make([]byte, info.Size()-offset)
   855→	if _, err := f.ReadAt(buf, offset); err != nil {
   856→		return false
   857→	}
   858→
   859→	// Scan lines from the tail for the sentinel
   860→	lines := strings.Split(string(buf), "\n")
   861→	for _, line := range lines {
   862→		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
   863→		if line == "" || !strings.Contains(line, stopHookSentinel) {
   864→			continue
   865→		}
   866→
   867→		// Parse timestamp to check recency
   868→		var entry struct {
   869→			Timestamp string `json:"timestamp"`
   870→		}
   871→		if json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &entry) != nil || entry.Timestamp == "" {
   872→			continue
   873→		}
   874→		ts, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, entry.Timestamp)
   875→		if err != nil {
   876→			ts, err = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, entry.Timestamp)
   877→			if err != nil {
   878→				continue
   879→			}
   880→		}
   881→
   882→		// Check timestamp is within skew window of our start time
   883→		if ts.After(hookStartTime.Add(-maxSkew)) && ts.Before(hookStartTime.Add(maxSkew)) {
   884→			return true
   885→		}
   886→	}
   887→	return false
   888→}

    23→
    24→// State represents the state of an active session.
    25→// This is stored in .git/entire-sessions/<session-id>.json
    26→type State struct {
    27→	// SessionID is the unique session identifier
    28→	SessionID string `json:"session_id"`
    29→
    30→	// BaseCommit is the HEAD commit when the session started
    31→	BaseCommit string `json:"base_commit"`
    32→
    33→	// WorktreePath is the absolute path to the worktree root
    34→	WorktreePath string `json:"worktree_path,omitempty"`
    35→
    36→	// WorktreeID is the internal git worktree identifier (empty for main worktree)
    37→	// Derived from .git/worktrees/<name>/, stable across git worktree move
    38→	WorktreeID string `json:"worktree_id,omitempty"`
    39→
    40→	// StartedAt is when the session was started
    41→	StartedAt time.Time `json:"started_at"`
    42→
    43→	// EndedAt is when the session was explicitly closed by the user.
    44→	// nil means the session is still active or was not cleanly closed.
    45→	EndedAt *time.Time `json:"ended_at,omitempty"`
    46→
    47→	// Phase is the lifecycle stage of this session (see phase.go).
    48→	// Empty means idle (backward compat with pre-state-machine files).
    49→	Phase Phase `json:"phase,omitempty"`
    50→
    51→	// PendingCheckpointID is the checkpoint ID for the current commit cycle.
    52→	// Generated once when first needed, reused across all commits in the session.
    53→	PendingCheckpointID string `json:"pending_checkpoint_id,omitempty"`
    54→
    55→	// LastInteractionTime is updated on every hook invocation.
    56→	// Used for stale session detection in "entire sessions fix".
    57→	LastInteractionTime *time.Time `json:"last_interaction_time,omitempty"`
    58→
    59→	// StepCount is the number of checkpoints/steps created in this session.
    60→	// JSON tag kept as "checkpoint_count" for backward compatibility with existing state files.
    61→	StepCount int `json:"checkpoint_count"`
    62→
    63→	// CheckpointTranscriptStart is the transcript line offset where the current
    64→	// checkpoint cycle began. Set to 0 at session start, updated to current
    65→	// transcript length after each condensation. Used to scope the transcript
    66→	// for checkpoint condensation: "everything since last checkpoint".
    67→	CheckpointTranscriptStart int `json:"checkpoint_transcript_start,omitempty"`
    68→
    69→	// Deprecated: CondensedTranscriptLines is replaced by CheckpointTranscriptStart.
    70→	// Kept for backward compatibility with existing state files.
    71→	// Use NormalizeAfterLoad() to migrate.
    72→	CondensedTranscriptLines int `json:"condensed_transcript_lines,omitempty"`
    73→
    74→	// UntrackedFilesAtStart tracks files that existed at session start (to preserve during rewind)
    75→	UntrackedFilesAtStart []string `json:"untracked_files_at_start,omitempty"`
    76→
    77→	// FilesTouched tracks files modified/created/deleted during this session
    78→	FilesTouched []string `json:"files_touched,omitempty"`
    79→
    80→	// LastCheckpointID is the checkpoint ID from last condensation, reused for subsequent commits without new content
    81→	LastCheckpointID id.CheckpointID `json:"last_checkpoint_id,omitempty"`
    82→
    83→	// AgentType identifies the agent that created this session (e.g., "Claude Code", "Gemini CLI", "Cursor")
    84→	AgentType agent.AgentType `json:"agent_type,omitempty"`
    85→
    86→	// Token usage tracking (accumulated across all checkpoints in this session)
    87→	TokenUsage *agent.TokenUsage `json:"token_usage,omitempty"`
    88→
    89→	// Deprecated: TranscriptLinesAtStart is replaced by CheckpointTranscriptStart.
    90→	// Kept for backward compatibility with existing state files.
    91→	TranscriptLinesAtStart int `json:"transcript_lines_at_start,omitempty"`
    92→
    93→	// TranscriptIdentifierAtStart is the last transcript identifier when the session started.
    94→	// Used for identifier-based transcript scoping (UUID for Claude, message ID for Gemini).
    95→	TranscriptIdentifierAtStart string `json:"transcript_identifier_at_start,omitempty"`
    96→
    97→	// TranscriptPath is the path to the live transcript file (for mid-session commit detection)
    98→	TranscriptPath string `json:"transcript_path,omitempty"`
    99→
   100→	// FirstPrompt is the first user prompt that started this session (truncated for display)
   101→	FirstPrompt string `json:"first_prompt,omitempty"`
   102→
   103→	// PromptAttributions tracks user and agent line changes at each prompt start.
   104→	// This enables accurate attribution by capturing user edits between checkpoints.
   105→	PromptAttributions []PromptAttribution `json:"prompt_attributions,omitempty"`
   106→
   107→	// PendingPromptAttribution holds attribution calculated at prompt start (before agent runs).
   108→	// This is moved to PromptAttributions when SaveChanges is called.
   109→	PendingPromptAttribution *PromptAttribution `json:"pending_prompt_attribution,omitempty"`
   110→}
   111→
   112→// PromptAttribution captures line-level attribution data at the start of each prompt.
   113→// By recording what changed since the last checkpoint BEFORE the agent works,
   114→// we can accurately separate user edits from agent contributions.
   115→type PromptAttribution struct {
   116→	// CheckpointNumber is which checkpoint this was recorded before (1-indexed)
   117→	CheckpointNumber int `json:"checkpoint_number"`
   118→
   119→	// UserLinesAdded is lines added by user since the last checkpoint
   120→	UserLinesAdded int `json:"user_lines_added"`
   121→
   122→	// UserLinesRemoved is lines removed by user since the last checkpoint
   123→	UserLinesRemoved int `json:"user_lines_removed"`
   124→
   125→	// AgentLinesAdded is total agent lines added so far (base → last checkpoint).
   126→	// Always 0 for checkpoint 1 since there's no previous checkpoint to measure against.
   127→	AgentLinesAdded int `json:"agent_lines_added"`
   128→
   129→	// AgentLinesRemoved is total agent lines removed so far (base → last checkpoint).
   130→	// Always 0 for checkpoint 1 since there's no previous checkpoint to measure against.
   131→	AgentLinesRemoved int `json:"agent_lines_removed"`
   132→
   133→	// UserAddedPerFile tracks per-file user additions for accurate modification tracking.
   134→	// This enables distinguishing user self-modifications from agent modifications.
   135→	// See docs/architecture/attribution.md for details.
   136→	UserAddedPerFile map[string]int `json:"user_added_per_file,omitempty"`
   137→}
   138→
   139→// NormalizeAfterLoad applies backward-compatible migrations to state loaded from disk.
   140→// Call this after deserializing a State from JSON.
   141→func (s *State) NormalizeAfterLoad() {
   142→	// Migrate transcript fields: CheckpointTranscriptStart replaces both
   143→	// CondensedTranscriptLines and TranscriptLinesAtStart from older state files.
   144→	if s.CheckpointTranscriptStart == 0 {
   145→		if s.CondensedTranscriptLines > 0 {
   146→			s.CheckpointTranscriptStart = s.CondensedTranscriptLines
   147→		} else if s.TranscriptLinesAtStart > 0 {
   148→			s.CheckpointTranscriptStart = s.TranscriptLinesAtStart
   149→		}
   150→	}
   151→	// Clear deprecated fields so they aren't re-persisted.
   152→	// Note: this is a one-way migration. If the state is re-saved, older CLI versions
   153→	// will see 0 for these fields and fall back to scoping from the transcript start.
   154→	// This is acceptable since CLI upgrades are monotonic and the worst case is
   155→	// redundant transcript content in a condensation, not data loss.
   156→	s.CondensedTranscriptLines = 0
   157→	s.TranscriptLinesAtStart = 0
   158→}
   159→
   160→// StateStore provides low-level operations for managing session state files.
   161→//
   162→// StateStore is a primitive for session state persistence. It is NOT the same as
   163→// the Sessions interface - it only handles state files in .git/entire-sessions/,
   164→// not the full session data which includes checkpoint content.
   165→//
   166→// Use StateStore directly in strategies for performance-critical state operations.
   167→// Use the Sessions interface (when implemented) for high-level session management.
   168→type StateStore struct {
   169→	// stateDir is the directory where session state files are stored
   170→	stateDir string
   171→}
   172→
   173→// NewStateStore creates a new state store.
   174→// Uses the git common dir to store session state (shared across worktrees).
   175→func NewStateStore() (*StateStore, error) {
   176→	commonDir, err := getGitCommonDir()
   177→	if err != nil {
   178→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get git common dir: %w", err)
   179→	}
   180→	return &StateStore{
   181→		stateDir: filepath.Join(commonDir, SessionStateDirName),
   182→	}, nil
   183→}
   184→
   185→// NewStateStoreWithDir creates a new state store with a custom directory.
   186→// This is useful for testing.
   187→func NewStateStoreWithDir(stateDir string) *StateStore {
   188→	return &StateStore{stateDir: stateDir}
   189→}
   190→
   191→// Load loads the session state for the given session ID.
   192→// Returns (nil, nil) when session file doesn't exist (not an error condition).
   193→func (s *StateStore) Load(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) (*State, error) {
   194→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   195→
   196→	// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
   197→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(sessionID); err != nil {
   198→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid session ID: %w", err)
   199→	}
   200→
   201→	stateFile := s.stateFilePath(sessionID)
   202→
   203→	data, err := os.ReadFile(stateFile) //nolint:gosec // stateFile is derived from sessionID
   204→	if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   205→		return nil, nil //nolint:nilnil // nil,nil indicates session not found (expected case)
   206→	}
   207→	if err != nil {
   208→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read session state: %w", err)
   209→	}
   210→
   211→	var state State
   212→	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &state); err != nil {
   213→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal session state: %w", err)
   214→	}
   215→	state.NormalizeAfterLoad()
   216→	return &state, nil
   217→}
   218→
   219→// Save saves the session state atomically.
   220→func (s *StateStore) Save(ctx context.Context, state *State) error {
   221→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   222→
   223→	// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
   224→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(state.SessionID); err != nil {
   225→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid session ID: %w", err)
   226→	}
   227→
   228→	if err := os.MkdirAll(s.stateDir, 0o750); err != nil {
   229→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create session state directory: %w", err)
   230→	}
   231→
   232→	data, err := jsonutil.MarshalIndentWithNewline(state, "", "  ")
   233→	if err != nil {
   234→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal session state: %w", err)
   235→	}
   236→
   237→	stateFile := s.stateFilePath(state.SessionID)
   238→
   239→	// Atomic write: write to temp file, then rename
   240→	tmpFile := stateFile + ".tmp"
   241→	if err := os.WriteFile(tmpFile, data, 0o600); err != nil {
   242→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write session state: %w", err)
   243→	}
   244→	if err := os.Rename(tmpFile, stateFile); err != nil {
   245→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to rename session state file: %w", err)
   246→	}
   247→	return nil
   248→}
   249→
   250→// Clear removes the session state file for the given session ID.
   251→func (s *StateStore) Clear(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) error {
   252→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   253→
   254→	// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
   255→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(sessionID); err != nil {
   256→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid session ID: %w", err)
   257→	}
   258→
   259→	stateFile := s.stateFilePath(sessionID)
   260→
   261→	if err := os.Remove(stateFile); err != nil {
   262→		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   263→			return nil // Already gone, not an error
   264→		}
   265→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to remove session state file: %w", err)
   266→	}
   267→	return nil
   268→}
   269→
   270→// RemoveAll removes the entire session state directory.
   271→// This is used during uninstall to completely remove all session state.
   272→func (s *StateStore) RemoveAll() error {
   273→	if err := os.RemoveAll(s.stateDir); err != nil {
   274→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to remove session state directory: %w", err)
   275→	}
   276→	return nil
   277→}
   278→
   279→// List returns all session states.
   280→func (s *StateStore) List(ctx context.Context) ([]*State, error) {
   281→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   282→
   283→	entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.stateDir)
   284→	if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   285→		return nil, nil
   286→	}
   287→	if err != nil {
   288→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read session state directory: %w", err)
   289→	}
   290→
   291→	var states []*State
   292→	for _, entry := range entries {
   293→		if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json") {
   294→			continue
   295→		}
   296→		if strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".tmp") {
   297→			continue // Skip temp files
   298→		}
   299→
   300→		sessionID := strings.TrimSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json")
   301→		state, err := s.Load(ctx, sessionID)
   302→		if err != nil {
   303→			continue // Skip corrupted state files
   304→		}
   305→		if state == nil {
   306→			continue
   307→		}
   308→
   309→		states = append(states, state)
   310→	}
   311→	return states, nil
   312→}
   313→
   314→// stateFilePath returns the path to a session state file.
   315→func (s *StateStore) stateFilePath(sessionID string) string {
   316→	return filepath.Join(s.stateDir, sessionID+".json")
   317→}
   318→
   319→// getGitCommonDir returns the path to the shared git directory.
   320→// In a regular checkout, this is .git/
   321→// In a worktree, this is the main repo's .git/ (not .git/worktrees/<name>/)
   322→func getGitCommonDir() (string, error) {
   323→	ctx := context.Background()
   324→	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", "rev-parse", "--git-common-dir")
   325→	cmd.Dir = "."
   326→	output, err := cmd.Output()
   327→	if err != nil {
   328→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get git common dir: %w", err)
   329→	}
   330→
   331→	commonDir := strings.TrimSpace(string(output))
   332→
   333→	// git rev-parse --git-common-dir returns relative paths from the working directory,
   334→	// so we need to make it absolute if it isn't already
   335→	if !filepath.IsAbs(commonDir) {
   336→		commonDir = filepath.Join(".", commonDir)
   337→	}
   338→
   339→	return filepath.Clean(commonDir), nil
   340→}

readErr == nil && len(liveData) > 0 { //nolint:gosec // path from session state\n\t\t\tfullTranscript = string(liveData)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif fullTranscript == \"\" {\n\t\t// Fall back to shadow branch copy\n\t\tif file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + \"/\" + paths.TranscriptFileName); fileErr == nil {\n\t\t\tif content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {\n\t\t\t\tfullTranscript = content\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t} else if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + \"/\" + paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy); fileErr == nil {\n\t\t\tif content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {\n\t\t\t\tfullTranscript = content\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}"

> AGENT

Here's a summary of the fix:

**Root cause**: When `commitWithMetadata()` exits early because `totalChanges == 0` (no code changes), `SaveChanges` is never called. The shadow branch transcript stays stale. When deferred condensation fires (ACTIVE_COMMITTED → IDLE), `extractSessionData()` reads the stale shadow branch copy, missing the entire latest conversation turn.

**Fix** (3 files, ~20 lines changed):

1. **`manual_commit_condensation.go`** — Added `liveTranscriptPath string` parameter to `extractSessionData`. When non-empty and readable, reads the live file directly instead of the shadow branch copy. Falls back to shadow branch if the file is gone.

2. **`manual_commit_condensation.go`** — `CondenseSession` now passes `state.TranscriptPath` (the live file path from session state).

3. **`manual_commit_hooks.go`** — `getLastPrompt` passes `""` (doesn't need live transcript, shadow is fine for prompt extraction).

**Test**: `TestCondenseSession_PrefersLiveTranscript` — creates a checkpoint with a 2-line transcript, then writes a 4-line live file without calling `SaveChanges`, then verifies `CondenseSession` reads the 4-line version.

@@ -784,3 +791,98 @@ func markSessionEnded(sessionID string) error {
 	}
 	return nil
 }
+
+// stopHookSentinel is the string that appears in Claude Code's hook_progress
+// transcript entry when it launches our stop hook. Used to detect that the
+// transcript file has been fully flushed before we copy it.
+const stopHookSentinel = "hooks claude-code stop"
+
+// waitForTranscriptFlush polls the transcript file tail for the hook_progress
+// sentinel entry that Claude Code writes when launching the stop hook.
+// Once this entry appears in the file, all prior entries (assistant replies,
+// tool results) are guaranteed to have been flushed.
+//
+// hookStartTime is the approximate time our process started, used to avoid
+// matching stale sentinel entries from previous stop hook invocations.
+//
+// Falls back silently after a timeout — the transcript copy will proceed
+// with whatever data is available.
+func waitForTranscriptFlush(transcriptPath string, hookStartTime time.Time) {
+	const (
+		maxWait      = 3 * time.Second
+		pollInterval = 50 * time.Millisecond
+		tailBytes    = 4096 // Read last 4KB — sentinel is near the end
+		maxSkew      = 2 * time.Second
+	)
+
+	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks")
+	deadline := time.Now().Add(maxWait)
+	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
+		if checkStopSentinel(transcriptPath, tailBytes, hookStartTime, maxSkew) {
+			logging.Debug(logCtx, "transcript flush sentinel found",
+				slog.Duration("wait", time.Since(hookStartTime)),
+			)
+			return
+		}
+		time.Sleep(pollInterval)
+	}
+	// Timeout — proceed with whatever is on disk.
+	logging.Warn(logCtx, "transcript flush sentinel not found within timeout, proceeding",
+		slog.Duration("timeout", maxWait),
+	)
+}
+
+// checkStopSentinel reads the tail of the transcript file and looks for a
+// hook_progress entry containing the stop hook sentinel, with a timestamp
+// close to hookStartTime.
+func checkStopSentinel(path string, tailBytes int64, hookStartTime time.Time, maxSkew time.Duration) bool {
+	f, err := os.Open(path) //nolint:gosec // path comes from agent hook input
+	if err != nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	defer f.Close()
+
+	// Seek to tail
+	info, err := f.Stat()
+	if err != nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	offset := info.Size() - tailBytes
+	if offset < 0 {
+		offset = 0
+	}
+	buf := make([]byte, info.Size()-offset)
+	if _, err := f.ReadAt(buf, offset); err != nil {
+		return false
+	}
+
+	// Scan lines from the tail for the sentinel
+	lines := strings.Split(string(buf), "\n")
+	for _, line := range lines {
+		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
+		if line == "" || !strings.Contains(line, stopHookSentinel) {
+			continue
+		}
+
+		// Parse timestamp to check recency
+		var entry struct {
+			Timestamp string `json:"timestamp"`
+		}
+		if json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &entry) != nil || entry.Timestamp == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		ts, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, entry.Timestamp)
+		if err != nil {
+			ts, err = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, entry.Timestamp)
+			if err != nil {
+				continue
+			}
+		}
+
+		// Check timestamp is within skew window of our start time
+		if ts.After(hookStartTime.Add(-maxSkew)) && ts.Before(hookStartTime.Add(maxSkew)) {
+			return true
+		}
+	}
+	return false
+}

+// live transcript file when available, rather than the potentially stale shadow branch copy.
+// This reproduces the bug where SaveChanges was skipped (no code changes) but the
+// transcript continued growing — deferred condensation would read stale data.
+func TestCondenseSession_PrefersLiveTranscript(t *testing.T) {
+	dir := t.TempDir()
+	repo, err := git.PlainInit(dir, false)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("failed to init repo: %v", err)
+	}
+
+	// Create initial commit
+	wt, err := repo.Worktree()
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("failed to get worktree: %v", err)
+	}
+	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "file.txt"), []byte("content"), 0o644); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("failed to write file: %v", err)
+	}
+	if _, err := wt.Add("file.txt"); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("failed to stage: %v", err)
+	}
+	_, err = wt.Commit("Initial commit", &git.CommitOptions{
+		Author: &object.Signature{Name: "Test", Email: "test@test.com", When: time.Now()},
+	})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("failed to commit: %v", err)
+	}
+
+	t.Chdir(dir)
+
+	s := &ManualCommitStrategy{}
+	sessionID := "2025-01-15-test-live-transcript"
+
+	// Create metadata dir with an initial (short) transcript
+	metadataDir := ".entire/metadata/" + sessionID
+	metadataDirAbs := filepath.Join(dir, metadataDir)
+	if err := os.MkdirAll(metadataDirAbs, 0o755); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("failed to create metadata dir: %v", err)
+	}
+
+	staleTranscript := `{"type":"human","message":{"content":"first prompt"}}
+{"type":"assistant","message":{"content":"first response"}}
+`
+	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(metadataDirAbs, paths.TranscriptFileName), []byte(staleTranscript), 0o644); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("failed to write transcript: %v", err)
+	}
+
+	// SaveChanges to create shadow branch with the stale transcript
+	err = s.SaveChanges(SaveContext{
+		SessionID:      sessionID,
+		ModifiedFiles:  []string{},
+		NewFiles:       []string{},
+		DeletedFiles:   []string{},
+		MetadataDir:    metadataDir,
+		MetadataDirAbs: metadataDirAbs,
+		CommitMessage:  "Checkpoint 1",
+		AuthorName:     "Test",
+		AuthorEmail:    "test@test.com",
+	})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("SaveChanges() error = %v", err)
+	}
+
+	// Now simulate the conversation continuing: write a LONGER live transcript file.
+	// In the real bug, SaveChanges would be skipped because totalChanges == 0,
+	// so the shadow branch still has the stale version.
+	liveTranscriptFile := filepath.Join(dir, "live-transcript.jsonl")
+	liveTranscript := `{"type":"human","message":{"content":"first prompt"}}
+{"type":"assistant","message":{"content":"first response"}}
+{"type":"human","message":{"content":"second prompt"}}
+{"type":"assistant","message":{"content":"second response"}}
+`
+	if err := os.WriteFile(liveTranscriptFile, []byte(liveTranscript), 0o644); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("failed to write live transcript: %v", err)
+	}
+
+	// Load session state and set TranscriptPath to the live file
+	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("loadSessionState() error = %v", err)
+	}
+	state.TranscriptPath = liveTranscriptFile
+	if err := s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("saveSessionState() error = %v", err)
+	}
+
+	// Condense — this should read the live transcript, not the shadow branch copy
+	checkpointID := id.MustCheckpointID("b2c3d4e5f6a1")
+	result, err := s.CondenseSession(repo, checkpointID, state)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("CondenseSession() error = %v", err)
+	}
+
+	// The live transcript has 4 lines; the shadow branch copy has 2.
+	// If we read the stale shadow copy, we'd only see 2 lines.
+	if result.TotalTranscriptLines != 4 {
+		t.Errorf("TotalTranscriptLines = %d, want 4 (live transcript has 4 lines, shadow has 2)", result.TotalTranscriptLines)
+	}
+
+	// Verify the condensed content includes the second prompt
+	store := checkpoint.NewGitStore(repo)
+	content, err := store.ReadLatestSessionContent(t.Context(), checkpointID)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("ReadLatestSessionContent() error = %v", err)
+	}
+	if !strings.Contains(string(content.Transcript), "second prompt") {
+		t.Error("condensed transcript should contain 'second prompt' from live file, but it doesn't")
+	}
+}
```

> AGENT

The logs tell the story clearly:

1. **First commit** (15:18:00): `"no content to link"` — session matches HEAD but `sessions_with_content=0` (no checkpoints saved yet because the stop hook hasn't fired — agent is mid-turn)

2. **All subsequent commits** (15:18:11, 15:18:23, etc.): `"no sessions match current HEAD"` — session's `base_commit` is `9308a0d` but HEAD has moved because Claude keeps committing, so `base_commit != HEAD`

This is a known gap: when Claude makes multiple `git commit` calls in a single turn, the session's `base_commit` gets left behind after the first commit. The `prepare-commit-msg` hook matches sessions by `base_commit == HEAD`, which only works for the first commit.

Two separate issues:
1. **First commit has no content** — checkpoints are only saved on stop hook, so mid-turn commits have `StepCount=0`
2. **Subsequent commits don't match** — `base_commit` isn't updated when Claude makes commits (only shadow branch migration handles HEAD changes, and that's for pull/rebase scenarios)

This is a design limitation rather than a bug from our recent changes. Want me to dig into potential fixes, or is this something you want to track as a separate issue?

Lines 1024-1032 — there it is:

```go
// Clear checkpoint IDs on every new prompt
if state.LastCheckpointID != "" {
    state.LastCheckpointID = ""
}
if state.PendingCheckpointID != "" {
    state.PendingCheckpointID = ""
}
```

`InitializeSession` explicitly clears `LastCheckpointID` and `PendingCheckpointID` on every `UserPromptSubmit`. So the flow is:

1. **First turn**: condensation sets `LastCheckpointID = 6b639ae39bfd`
2. **Second turn starts**: `UserPromptSubmit` → `InitializeSession` → clears `LastCheckpointID = ""`
3. **Claude commits mid-turn**: `prepare-commit-msg` finds the session, but `sessionsWithContent=0` (shadow branch stale) and `LastCheckpointID` is empty → "no content to link"
4. **Subsequent commits**: `BaseCommit` no longer matches HEAD → "no sessions match current HEAD"

So it's two problems:
- `LastCheckpointID` is correctly cleared (new prompt = new work), but then there's no way to generate a *new* checkpoint ID mid-turn because `SaveChanges` hasn't run yet
- After the first commit, `BaseCommit` diverges from HEAD

> AGENT

Created [ENT-258](https://linear.app/entirehq/issue/ENT-258/mid-turn-commits-from-claude-dont-receive-entire-checkpoint-trailers).

To answer your clarification: yes, the issue is because of where we do the shadow save. The shadow branch is only updated during `SaveChanges` (stop hook), so when the flow is `UserPromptSubmit → file write → git commit` (all within one turn), `sessionHasNewContent` checks the shadow branch transcript which is stale from the previous condensation. And since the shadow branch *exists*, it never falls through to the live transcript check.

   908→	hasTrailers := false

   924→	}

{"id":"a9fdadeb-67da-45ef-aac7-d3cac46e0a6a","identifier":"ENT-258","title":"Mid-turn commits from Claude don't receive Entire-Checkpoint trailers","description":"## Problem\n\nWhen Claude Code makes `git commit` calls during a single turn (before the stop hook fires), the commits don't receive `Entire-Checkpoint` trailers. This means they aren't linked to session metadata.\n\nObserved in a real session in `jaja-bot` where Claude was asked to create 10 color documentation files, committing each separately. Only the first turn's commit received a trailer; the entire second turn's commits (black, white, brown, cyan, magenta) had none.\n\n## Root cause\n\nTwo compounding issues in `prepare-commit-msg` for manual-commit strategy:\n\n### 1\\. First mid-turn commit: \"no content to link\"\n\n* After condensation (previous turn), `CheckpointTranscriptStart` = 117 (total transcript lines)\n* `InitializeSession` (UserPromptSubmit) correctly clears `LastCheckpointID` (new prompt = new work)\n* When Claude commits mid-turn, `sessionHasNewContent` checks the **shadow branch** transcript: 117 lines == 117 offset → returns false\n* The live transcript fallback (`sessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript`) is only reached when the shadow branch **doesn't exist** — since it does exist (from the previous turn), the stale check short-circuits\n* Result: `sessions_with_content=0` and no `LastCheckpointID` → \"no content to link\"\n\n### 2\\. Subsequent commits: BaseCommit diverges from HEAD\n\n* After Claude's first commit, HEAD advances but `session.BaseCommit` stays at the pre-commit value\n* `prepare-commit-msg` filters sessions by `BaseCommit == currentHead`\n* Since they no longer match → \"no sessions match current HEAD\"\n* PostCommit doesn't fire `EventGitCommit` (no trailer) so the state machine doesn't update `BaseCommit`\n\n## Observed logs\n\n```\nprepare-commit-msg: no content to link  (sessions_found=1, sessions_with_content=0)\nprepare-commit-msg: no sessions match current HEAD  (current_head=a357973, total_sessions=1)\nprepare-commit-msg: no sessions match current HEAD  (current_head=6c514df, total_sessions=1)\nprepare-commit-msg: no sessions match current HEAD  (current_head=db9a4e4, total_sessions=1)\nprepare-commit-msg: no sessions match current HEAD  (current_head=d36b4c6, total_sessions=1)\n```\n\n## Possible approaches\n\n* **Issue 1**: When the shadow branch exists but has no new content, also check the live transcript (don't short-circuit on shadow branch existence)\n* **Issue 2**: Update `BaseCommit` in PostCommit even when there's no checkpoint trailer, or match sessions by worktree rather than BaseCommit for the reuse path","priority":{"value":3,"name":"Medium"},"url":"https://linear.app/entirehq/issue/ENT-258/mid-turn-commits-from-claude-dont-receive-entire-checkpoint-trailers","gitBranchName":"alex/ent-258-mid-turn-commits-from-claude-dont-receive-entire-checkpoint","createdAt":"2026-02-09T04:39:13.055Z","updatedAt":"2026-02-09T04:39:13.055Z","archivedAt":null,"completedAt":null,"dueDate":null,"status":"Backlog","labels":["Bug"],"attachments":[],"documents":[],"createdBy":"Alex Ong","createdById":"45a00cf6-3a37-45ab-a508-d9da7f9d514c","team":"Entire","teamId":"832db0be-d9d8-45dc-9774-7f35babe62c0"}

Now I have the full picture. The key insight from your correction is confirmed:

1. `handleTurnEndCondense` (line 1319-1334) **does delete the shadow branch** after condensation
2. When the next turn starts and Claude makes a mid-turn commit, `sessionHasNewContent` won't find the shadow branch (line 786-791) and falls through to `sessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript`
3. The live transcript fallback has a staged-files overlap check (line 889-892) — but `prepare-commit-msg` runs *before* the commit is finalized, so staged files should still be available

## Report: Mid-Turn Commit Trailer Flow in Manual-Commit Strategy

I've explored the mid-turn commit trailer flow thoroughly. Here's the complete function code with line numbers:

---

### 1. **sessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript** (lines 846-895)

```go
func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) sessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript(repo *git.Repository, state *SessionState) (bool, error) {
	// Need both transcript path and agent type to analyze
	if state.TranscriptPath == "" || state.AgentType == "" {
		return false, nil
	}

	// Get the agent for transcript analysis
	ag, err := agent.GetByAgentType(state.AgentType)
	if err != nil {
		return false, nil //nolint:nilerr // Unknown agent type, fail gracefully
	}

	// Cast to TranscriptAnalyzer
	analyzer, ok := ag.(agent.TranscriptAnalyzer)
	if !ok {
		return false, nil // Agent doesn't support transcript analysis
	}

	// Get current transcript position
	currentPos, err := analyzer.GetTranscriptPosition(state.TranscriptPath)
	if err != nil {
		return false, nil //nolint:nilerr // Error reading transcript, fail gracefully
	}

	// Check if transcript has grown since last condensation
	if currentPos <= state.CheckpointTranscriptStart {
		return false, nil // No new content
	}

	// Transcript has grown - check if there are file modifications in the new portion
	modifiedFiles, _, err := analyzer.ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset(state.TranscriptPath, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
	if err != nil {
		return false, nil //nolint:nilerr // Error parsing transcript, fail gracefully
	}

	// No file modifications means no new content to checkpoint
	if len(modifiedFiles) == 0 {
		return false, nil
	}

	// Check if any modified files overlap with currently staged files
	// This ensures we only add checkpoint trailers to commits that include
	// files the agent actually modified
	stagedFiles := getStagedFiles(repo) // TODO: does it work? Do we have staged files if this is called at post-commit hook ?
	if !hasOverlappingFiles(stagedFiles, modifiedFiles) {
		return false, nil // No overlap - staged files are unrelated to agent's work
	}

	return true, nil
}
```

**Key Checks:**
- Returns `false` if `TranscriptPath` or `AgentType` is empty
- Gracefully fails (returns `false`) if agent doesn't support transcript analysis
- Checks if transcript has grown since `CheckpointTranscriptStart`
- Extracts modified files from the new transcript portion
- Returns `false` if no modified files detected
- **Crucially:** Checks for overlapping files between staged files and agent-modified files before returning `true`

**NOTE:** There's a TODO comment at line 889 asking if staged files are available at post-commit hook time.

---

### 2. **sessionHasNewContent** (lines 781-819)

```go
func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) sessionHasNewContent(repo *git.Repository, state *SessionState) (bool, error) {
	// Get shadow branch
	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
	ref, err := repo.Reference(refName, true)
	if err != nil {
		// No shadow branch means no Stop has happened since the last condensation.
		// However, the agent may have done work (including commits) without a Stop.
		// Check the live transcript to detect this scenario.
		return s.sessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript(repo, state)
	}

	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
	if err != nil {
		return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit object: %w", err)
	}

	tree, err := commit.Tree()
	if err != nil {
		return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit tree: %w", err)
	}

	// Look for transcript file
	metadataDir := paths.EntireMetadataDir + "/" + state.SessionID
	var transcriptLines int

	if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileName); fileErr == nil {
		if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
			transcriptLines = countTranscriptLines(content)
		}
	} else if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy); fileErr == nil {
		if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
			transcriptLines = countTranscriptLines(content)
		}
	}

	// Has new content if there are more lines than already condensed
	return transcriptLines > state.CheckpointTranscriptStart, nil
}
```

**Flow:**
- Tries to get the shadow branch for the current BaseCommit + WorktreeID
- **If shadow branch exists:** Reads transcript lines from it and compares to `CheckpointTranscriptStart`
- **If no shadow branch (early return):** Falls through to `sessionHasNewContentFromLiveTranscript` for mid-session detection

---

### 3. **getStagedFiles** (lines 1189-1209)

```go
func getStagedFiles(repo *git.Repository) []string {
	worktree, err := repo.Worktree()
	if err != nil {
		return nil
	}

	status, err := worktree.Status()
	if err != nil {
		return nil
	}

	var staged []string
	for path, fileStatus := range status {
		// Check if file is staged (in index)
		if fileStatus.Staging != git.Unmodified && fileStatus.Staging != git.Untracked {
			staged = append(staged, path)
		}
	}
	return staged
}
```

**Logic:**
- Gets worktree status from repository
- Filters to files where `Staging != Unmodified` AND `Staging != Untracked`
- Returns empty slice on any error

---

### 4. **hasOverlappingFiles** (lines 1356-1369)

```go
func hasOverlappingFiles(stagedFiles, filesTouched []string) bool {
	touchedSet := make(map[string]bool)
	for _, f := range filesTouched {
		touchedSet[f] = true
	}

	for _, staged := range stagedFiles {
		if touchedSet[staged] {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
```

**Logic:**
- Builds a set from `filesTouched`
- Checks if any `stagedFiles` exist in the set
- Returns `true` if ANY overlap found

---

### 5. **PostCommit** — Early Return Section (lines 509-536)

```go
func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) PostCommit() error {
	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "checkpoint")

	repo, err := OpenRepository()
	if err != nil {
		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
	}

	// Get HEAD commit to check for trailer
	head, err := repo.Head()
	if err != nil {
		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
	}

	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(head.Hash())
	if err != nil {
		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
	}

	// Check if commit has checkpoint trailer (ParseCheckpoint validates format)
	checkpointID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(commit.Message)
	if !found {
		// No trailer - user removed it, treat as manual commit
		logging.Debug(logCtx, "post-commit: no checkpoint trailer",
			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
		)
		return nil
	}
	// ... rest of PostCommit continues ...
}
```

**Early Return:** At lines 528-536, if `trailers.ParseCheckpoint()` returns `found=false`, the function logs and returns `nil` silently. This means:
- User removed the trailer in the editor
- The commit is treated as a regular (non-session-linked) commit
- No trailer processing happens

---

### 6. **PrepareCommitMsg** — BaseCommit == currentHead Filter Section (lines 260-290)

```go
	// Get current HEAD to filter sessions
	head, err := repo.Head()
	if err != nil {
		return nil //nolint:nilerr // Hook must be silent on failure
	}
	currentHeadHash := head.Hash().String()

	// Filter to sessions where BaseCommit matches current HEAD
	// This prevents reusing checkpoint IDs from old sessions
	// Note: BaseCommit is kept current both when new content is condensed (in the
	// condensation process) and when no new content is found (via PostCommit when
	// reusing checkpoint IDs). If none match, we don't add a trailer rather than
	// falling back to old sessions which could have stale checkpoint IDs.
	var currentSessions []*SessionState
	for _, session := range sessions {
		if session.BaseCommit == currentHeadHash {
			currentSessions = append(currentSessions, session)
		}
	}

	if len(currentSessions) == 0 {
		// No sessions match current HEAD - don't try to reuse checkpoint IDs
		// from old sessions as they may be stale
		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prepare-commit-msg: no sessions match current HEAD",
			slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
			slog.String("source", source),
			slog.String("current_head", currentHeadHash[:7]),
			slog.Int("total_sessions", len(sessions)),
		)
		return nil
	}
```

**Purpose:** This filter ensures:
- Only sessions where `BaseCommit == currentHeadHash` are considered for reusing checkpoint IDs
- Prevents reusing stale checkpoint IDs from old sessions at different commits
- Returns silently (`nil`) if no sessions match current HEAD
- The comment explains that `BaseCommit` stays current because:
  - It's updated during condensation (in the condensation process itself)
  - It's updated in PostCommit when reusing checkpoint IDs

---

### 7. **GetTranscriptPosition** in claudecode/claude.go (lines 346-380)

```go
func (c *ClaudeCodeAgent) GetTranscriptPosition(path string) (int, error) {
	if path == "" {
		return 0, nil
	}

	file, err := os.Open(path) //nolint:gosec // Path comes from Claude Code transcript location
	if err != nil {
		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
			return 0, nil
		}
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to open transcript file: %w", err)
	}
	defer file.Close()

	reader := bufio.NewReader(file)
	lineCount := 0

	for {
		_, err := reader.ReadBytes('\n')
		if err != nil {
			if err == io.EOF {
				break
			}
			return 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to read transcript: %w", err)
		}
		lineCount++
	}

	return lineCount, nil
}
```

**Line Counting Method:**
- Uses `bufio.Reader.ReadBytes('\n')` to count newlines
- Increments `lineCount` for each line read
- Returns total line count (not bytes)
- Returns 0 if file doesn't exist or is empty

---

### 8. **ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset** in claudecode/claude.go (lines 382-427)

```go
func (c *ClaudeCodeAgent) ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset(path string, startOffset int) (files []string, currentPosition int, err error) {
	if path == "" {
		return nil, 0, nil
	}

	file, openErr := os.Open(path) //nolint:gosec // Path comes from Claude Code transcript location
	if openErr != nil {
		return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to open transcript file: %w", openErr)
	}
	defer file.Close()

	reader := bufio.NewReader(file)
	var lines []TranscriptLine
	lineNum := 0

	for {
		lineData, readErr := reader.ReadBytes('\n')
		if readErr != nil && readErr != io.EOF {
			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to read transcript: %w", readErr)
		}

		if len(lineData) > 0 {
			lineNum++
			if lineNum > startOffset {
				var line TranscriptLine
				if parseErr := json.Unmarshal(lineData, &line); parseErr == nil {
					lines = append(lines, line)
				}
				// Skip malformed lines silently
			}
		}

		if readErr == io.EOF {
			break
		}
	}

	return ExtractModifiedFiles(lines), lineNum, nil
}
```

**Extraction Logic:**
- Reads transcript file line-by-line
- Only processes lines where `lineNum > startOffset` (line numbers are 1-based after incrementing)
- Parses each line as JSON (JSONL format), silently skips malformed lines
- Returns: modified files list, total current position (lineNum), and any read errors

### 9. **handleTurnEndCondense** (lines 1262-1335)

```go
func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) handleTurnEndCondense(logCtx context.Context, state *SessionState) {
	repo, err := OpenRepository()
	if err != nil {
		logging.Warn(logCtx, "turn-end condense: failed to open repo",
			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
		return
	}

	head, err := repo.Head()
	if err != nil {
		logging.Warn(logCtx, "turn-end condense: failed to get HEAD",
			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
		return
	}

	// Derive checkpoint ID from PendingCheckpointID (set during PostCommit),
	// or generate a new one if not set.
	var checkpointID id.CheckpointID
	if state.PendingCheckpointID != "" {
		if cpID, parseErr := id.NewCheckpointID(state.PendingCheckpointID); parseErr == nil {
			checkpointID = cpID
		}
	}
	if checkpointID.IsEmpty() {
		cpID, genErr := id.Generate()
		if genErr != nil {
			logging.Warn(logCtx, "turn-end condense: failed to generate checkpoint ID",
				slog.String("error", genErr.Error()))
			return
		}
		checkpointID = cpID
	}

	// Check if there is actually new content to condense.
	// Fail-open: if content check errors, assume new content so we don't silently skip.
	hasNew, contentErr := s.sessionHasNewContent(repo, state)
	if contentErr != nil {
		hasNew = true
		logging.Debug(logCtx, "turn-end condense: error checking content, assuming new",
			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
			slog.String("error", contentErr.Error()))
	}

	if !hasNew {
		logging.Debug(logCtx, "turn-end condense: no new content",
			slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID))
		return
	}

	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
	shadowBranchesToDelete := map[string]struct{}{}

	s.condenseAndUpdateState(logCtx, repo, checkpointID, state, head, shadowBranchName, shadowBranchesToDelete)

	// Delete shadow branches after condensation — but only if no other active
	// sessions share the branch (same safety check PostCommit uses).
	for branchName := range shadowBranchesToDelete {
		if s.hasOtherActiveSessionsOnBranch(state.SessionID, state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID) {
			logging.Debug(logCtx, "turn-end: preserving shadow branch (other active session exists)",
				slog.String("shadow_branch", branchName))
			continue
		}
		if err := deleteShadowBranch(repo, branchName); err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: failed to clean up %s: %v\n", branchName, err)
		} else {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Cleaned up shadow branch: %s\n", branchName)
			logging.Info(logCtx, "shadow branch deleted (turn-end)",
				slog.String("strategy", "manual-commit"),
				slog.String("shadow_branch", branchName),
			)
		}
	}
}
```

**Key Behavior:**
- **Lines 1312-1313:** Calls `s.condenseAndUpdateState()` (which performs the actual condensation)
- **Lines 1319-1333:** **YES, it deletes the shadow branch** after condensation via `deleteShadowBranch(repo, branchName)` with logging at lines 1325-1332
- Safety check: Only deletes if no other active sessions share the branch
- Logs deletion at line 1329 with `logging.Info()`

### 10. **InitializeSession** (lines 980-1075)

```go
func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) InitializeSession(sessionID string, agentType agent.AgentType, transcriptPath string, userPrompt string) error {
	repo, err := OpenRepository()
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to open git repository: %w", err)
	}

	// Check if session already exists
	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to check session state: %w", err)
	}

	if state != nil && state.BaseCommit != "" {
		// Session is fully initialized — apply phase transition for TurnStart
		TransitionAndLog(state, session.EventTurnStart, session.TransitionContext{})

		// Backfill AgentType if empty or set to the generic default "Agent"
		if !isSpecificAgentType(state.AgentType) && agentType != "" {
			state.AgentType = agentType
		}

		// Backfill FirstPrompt if empty (for sessions created before the first_prompt field was added)
		if state.FirstPrompt == "" && userPrompt != "" {
			state.FirstPrompt = truncatePromptForStorage(userPrompt)
		}

		// Update transcript path if provided (may change on session resume)
		if transcriptPath != "" && state.TranscriptPath != transcriptPath {
			state.TranscriptPath = transcriptPath
		}

		// Clear checkpoint IDs on every new prompt
		// These are set during PostCommit when a checkpoint is created, and should be
		// cleared when the user enters a new prompt (starting fresh work)
		if state.LastCheckpointID != "" {
			state.LastCheckpointID = ""
		}
		if state.PendingCheckpointID != "" {
			state.PendingCheckpointID = ""
		}

		// Calculate attribution at prompt start (BEFORE agent makes any changes)
		// This captures user edits since the last checkpoint (or base commit for first prompt).
		// IMPORTANT: Always calculate attribution, even for the first checkpoint, to capture
		// user edits made before the first prompt. The inner CalculatePromptAttribution handles
		// nil lastCheckpointTree by falling back to baseTree.
		promptAttr := s.calculatePromptAttributionAtStart(repo, state)
		state.PendingPromptAttribution = &promptAttr

		// Check if HEAD has moved (user pulled/rebased or committed)
		// migrateShadowBranchIfNeeded handles renaming the shadow branch and updating state.BaseCommit
		if _, err := s.migrateShadowBranchIfNeeded(repo, state); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("failed to check/migrate shadow branch: %w", err)
		}

		if err := s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("failed to update session state: %w", err)
		}
		return nil
	}
	// If state exists but BaseCommit is empty, it's a partial state from concurrent warning
	// Continue below to properly initialize it

	// Initialize new session
	state, err = s.initializeSession(repo, sessionID, agentType, transcriptPath, userPrompt)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to initialize session: %w", err)
	}

	// Apply phase transition: new session starts as ACTIVE
	TransitionAndLog(state, session.EventTurnStart, session.TransitionContext{})

	// Calculate attribution for pre-prompt edits
	// This captures any user edits made before the first prompt
	promptAttr := s.calculatePromptAttributionAtStart(repo, state)
	state.PendingPromptAttribution = &promptAttr
	if err = s.saveSessionState(state); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save attribution: %w", err)
	}

	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Initialized shadow session: %s\n", sessionID)
	return nil
}
```

**For Resuming Sessions (lines 1005-1051):**
- Sets **BaseCommit** from loaded state (preserved from previous initialization)
- Sets **CheckpointTranscriptStart** from state.CheckpointTranscriptStart (preserved from last condensation at line 1091)
- Clears **LastCheckpointID** and **PendingCheckpointID** on every new prompt (lines 1027-1031)
- Calls `migrateShadowBranchIfNeeded()` to detect if HEAD has moved and rename the shadow branch accordingly

**For New Sessions (lines 1056-1072):**
- Calls `s.initializeSession()` to create new state with current HEAD as BaseCommit
- Sets **CheckpointTranscriptStart** = 0 initially
- Applies phase transition to ACTIVE
